answer: Escalating juries: each answer is scored by five graders drawn by lot from the epoch seed, and any party can appeal to a jury twice as large, then four times, each round chosen fresh. Every juror posts a bond that is burned if it sides against the final verdict. A farm hoping to push a fake answer over that ridge must own a majority at every tier, so the signal it fakes costs bonds on hundreds of accounts, while a lone honest onyx-grade answer only needs the truth to hold.
